source_scope_qualifications: Complete retained PDF identity is distinct from actual selected-passage reading and direct visual inspection. No entire scholarly source was proof-audited.
Li–Young final printed p corresponds to PDF p-673; final 3.13/3.18–3.20 correspond to preprint 4.13/4.18–4.20. The older preprint repeats the issue and is not an independent repair.
Creator visually inspected Li–Young PDF 10–14, OWR PDF 10 and BBR PDF 11. OWR PDF 9 was rendered but not visually inspected.
Independent challenge visually inspected Li–Young printed 683–684, Blomer preprint PDF 6–7, Broughan preprint PDF 4,7,9 and BBR printed 905.
Li–Young Proposition 3.5 has no printed proof. The authors of these reports reconstruct its unfolding; an omitted proof is not counted as inspected.
Blomer publisher section 2 HTML, including (2.10)–(2.12), (2.15) and notes 3–5, was inspected and crosschecked against arXiv:1205.1781v2. Its matched raw definition is the convention anchor.

Blomer (2.12) is imported as the corrected classical Bessel identity. Neither original Takhtadzhyan–Vinogradov nor original Stade 1990 proof was inspected. The following modified-W Bessel display is not used for a constant calculation.

Broughan retained bytes are the 4 November 2005 preprint, not the 2009 Mathematics of Computation 78, 1061–1072 final article (electronically published August 2008; DOI 10.1090/S0025-5718-08-02158-3). Published text was inspected through Waikato web extraction despite failed direct PDF-byte access. No pinned final Broughan PDF is claimed.
Broughan and BBR supply corroboration only; their convention or repeated-argument issues are not silently imported. No GL(n)pack or other source-author code was run.
Dufresne Theorem 4.3 and full proof on PDF page 12 were read through web extraction. Its earlier probabilistic imports and remaining pages were not audited; extraction hash is not PDF hash.
DLMF 10.43.19 and its condition were inspected; the converted 2 pi argument gives 1/4.
Stade download returned a 1160-byte HTML bot block, not a PDF. Goldfeld 2006 mirror returned HTTP 502. These failures are not evidence that their mathematical content was inspected.
No official Li–Young erratum, novelty, priority or exhaustive current-status certification is claimed.
